name: BottomNav
description: Bottom navigation with workspace actions and an optional chat input.
code:
<BottomNav
  tabs={[
    { id: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
    { id: 'search', label: 'Search', icon: 'search' },
    { id: 'chat', label: 'Chat', icon: 'message' },
  ]}
  activeTab="home"
  onTabChange={(id) => setActiveTab(id)}
  darkMode={isDark}
  onToggleDarkMode={() => setIsDark(!isDark)}
/>
documentation:
# BottomNav

Floating bottom navigation bar with tab switching, add menu, profile menu, and chat input morph.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| tabs | `Array<{id, label, icon}>` | `[]` | Tab definitions |
| activeTab | `string` | — | Currently active tab id |
| onTabChange | `(id) => void` | — | Tab change callback |
| addItems | `Array<{label, icon, iconColor?, onAction}>` | `[]` | Create menu items |
| notifications | `{[tabId]: number}` | `{}` | Notification counts per tab |
| avatarUrl | `string` | — | Profile image URL |
| profile | `{name, email}` | — | User profile data |
| profileItems | `Array<{label, icon, danger?, onAction}>` | `[]` | Profile menu items |
| chatTabId | `string` | `'chat'` | Which tab triggers chat mode |
| onSendMessage | `(msg) => void` | — | Chat send callback |
| darkMode | `boolean` | `false` | Current dark mode state |
| onToggleDarkMode | `() => void` | — | Dark mode toggle callback |

## Dependencies

- `lib/icon.jsx`
- `lib/popover.js`
- `lib/use-click-outside.js`
- `lib/use-is-mobile.js`
- `tokens/theme.css`
- `lucide-react` (peer)

## Usage

```jsx
import { BottomNav } from './components/bottom-nav'

<BottomNav
  tabs={[
    { id: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
    { id: 'search', label: 'Search', icon: 'search' },
    { id: 'chat', label: 'Chat', icon: 'message' },
  ]}
  activeTab="home"
  onTabChange={(id) => setActiveTab(id)}
  darkMode={isDark}
  onToggleDarkMode={() => setIsDark(!isDark)}
/>
```

## CSS Variables Used

`--inv-bg`, `--inv-nav`, `--inv-accent`


## Family precision

Hidden menu and chat/navigation layers are inert. Menus support shared keyboard navigation, skip disabled actions and restore trigger focus on Escape. Original artwork and choreography remain.

| activeTab | `string` | — | Active tab id |
| onTabChange | `(id) => void` | — | Tab change callback |
| variant | `'default'\|'subdued'` | `'default'` | `default`: white bg + hover indicator. `subdued`: bg-alt track + raised white indicator |
| label | `string` | `View options` | Accessible group name |
| disabled | `boolean` | `false` | Disable all choices |
| className | `string` | `''` | Additional CSS classes |

# ActionButton

The original morphing action now follows the real operation promise. Pending retains focus and blocks duplicate activation. Rejection shows a retryable error; success resets after resetAfterMs.

```tsx
import { ActionButton } from "@highway/react";
<ActionButton label="Save" onAction={saveRecord} onActionError={reportError} />
```

Return the actual promise from saveRecord. loadingDuration is deprecated and ignored; never simulate business success with a timer. The canonical API above contains every prop.
props: Return the real operation promise; rejection retains a retryable action
Compatibility only; does not determine completion

name: Table
description: Data table with sortable columns, row selection, and hover highlighting. Uses subdued bg-alt background.
documentation:
# Table

Use rowKey with unique stable IDs for changing datasets. selectedKeys and onSelectedKeysChange provide controlled selection by ID. The legacy onSelectionChange callback continues to return original input indices.

Sort headers are keyboard-operable buttons with aria-sort; selection uses labelled checkboxes and a mixed select-all state. Select-all applies to the supplied rows while preserving other controlled keys.

Sorting is client-side over supplied rows; this is not a virtualized spreadsheet. For large datasets, page data in the host and retain selection there. See the canonical API above.

Set collapseBelow on secondary columns to move their values alongside the first column when the table container is narrower than that pixel width. Values remain visible; resizing and sorting animate their positions and respect reduced motion. The showcase width slider changes the available container width.
props: Column definitions. render(value, row) for custom cells
